GRUNT STYLE X FOLDS OF HONOR: END OF WATCH PROGRAM

Grunt Style is proud to partner with Folds of Honor, a nonprofit dedicated to providing educational scholarships to the families of America’s fallen or disabled service members and first responders. Together, through the End of Watch Program, we will honor a new family every month for the 12 months, ensuring their loved one’s legacy is carried forward.

Each month, a custom-designed shirt will be created in collaboration with the family of a fallen first responder. All profits from these shirts will benefit the family and others just like them through the Folds of Honor scholarship program. By purchasing these shirts, you’re providing critical support to these families and helping ensure their hero’s legacy lives on.

Join us in making a lasting impact. Support here and carry their legacy forward. Together, we can make a difference, one family at a time.

settings.heading: FAQ
settings.row_content:
What is the End of Watch Program?

The End of Watch Program is a collaboration between Grunt Style and Folds of Honor to honor fallen first responders. Each month, we create a custom-designed shirt to pay tribute to these heroes, with 70% of the profits going directly to the family and 30% being donated to the Folds of Honor’s scholarship program. This initiative aims to provide both financial support and educational opportunities for the families left behind.

How does the program work?

Each month, a new shirt is created in collaboration with the family of a fallen first responder. All profits from these shirts directly benefit the family, with a portion being donated by Grunt Style to the Folds of Honor to be applied  toward the scholarship initiatives of Folds of Honor. This partnership ensures that the hero’s legacy lives on through financial and educational support.

Who does the program benefit?

The program supports families of fallen first responders by providing financial aid through the profits from shirt sales. Additionally, part of the proceeds are donated to the Folds of Honor to be utilized for additional educational scholarships, giving these families opportunities for a brighter future.

What happens to the profits from shirt sales?

The profits from each sale are allocated as follows:

  • 70% goes directly to the family of the honored fallen hero.
  • 30% is donated to the Folds of Honor scholarship program, providing educational assistance to families.

Can I get discounts on these products?

The End of Watch Program shirts are sold at their standard price, with no discounts offered. However, each purchase directly supports the families of fallen heroes and contributes to Folds of Honor’s mission, ensuring every dollar makes a meaningful impact.

For even more of your questions answered, please visit our dedicated FAQ page for the End of Watch Program.
